title: Marvel Legends Series Gambit | Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday Movie Collectible 6-Inch X-Men Action Figure Gift
features: MARVEL STUDIOS' AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: Collectible figure is inspired by Gambit's movie appearance -- for fans ages 4 and up
FILM-INSPIRED ACCESSORIES: Officially licensed Hasbro Marvel Legends set comes with 6 accessories, including 3 alternate hands, bo staff, and 2 kinetically charged playing card effects
PREMIUM DESIGN AND DECO: Fans and collectors can display this premium figure with movie-accurate design and deco in their collection
6-INCH SCALE ACTION FIGURE: Features a window box package and movie branding for display. Figure is designed at the Marvel 6 inch action figure scale (15 cm)
DISPLAY-WORTHY ARTICULATION: Collectible action figure features over 20 points of articulation with fully poseable head, arms, and legs
FIRST YOU CHARGE THE CARD: Though Gambit would rather solve a problem using his Cajun charm over violence, don’t expect him to go down quietly when he and the X-Men are facing the end of his world
BUILD A MULTIVERSE OF MARVEL COLLECTIBLES: Marvel gifts are great for play or display! Add to any collection of Marvel Legends Series figures. (Each sold separately. Subject to availability)
